# Determinism census (#2515)

Scope: unordered collections in the foundation import path, codegen context and emitters, and sema budget collection. A site is fixed when iteration can affect emitted Rust, generated bytes, diagnostics, or a key. Lookup-only and existence checks are recorded as order-free.

## Fixed byte-affecting sites

- `crates/jet-codegen/src/Codegen/Context.rs:1080-1087`: `unit_labels.values()` now filters base labels and selects by `(symbol, name)`, so equal symbols cannot choose a random label.
- `crates/jet-codegen/src/Codegen/Context.rs:1190-1202,1209-1221`: inline Core and foreign import maps now select the minimum `(scope, module)` candidate instead of the first HashMap value.
- `crates/jet-codegen/src/Codegen/Context.rs:3582-3592`: dependency roots now select by longest root depth, then package name.
- `crates/jet-codegen/src/Codegen/Items.rs:428-439`: memoized struct members use sorted `(field, type)` entries.
- `crates/jet-codegen/src/Codegen/Items.rs:683-693`: columnar-row memo initializers use sorted field names.
- `crates/jet-codegen/src/Codegen/Items.rs:1051-1061`: CLI decode initializers use sorted memo field names.
- `crates/jet-codegen/src/Codegen/Items.rs:1103-1110`: patch apply fields use sorted memo field names.
- `crates/jet-codegen/src/Codegen/mod.rs:178-186`: bundle Core aliases use `BTreeMap`; callers cannot observe HashMap iteration order.
- `crates/jet-codegen/src/Codegen/TIR/eval/mod.rs:5042-5055,5075-5136,5250-5255,5598-5655`: runtime interpreter Core import maps now use `BTreeMap`; the legacy `run_program` HashMap API is copied into ordered storage once at the boundary.

## Proven order-free sites

- `crates/jet-foundation/src/AST/program_imports.rs:159-190`: Core maps are populated by source-order imports and only returned for keyed lookup. `walk_bindings` and `foreign_imports` at `:321-395` use `Vec` source order.
- `crates/jet-codegen/src/Codegen/Context.rs:1306-1307`: `boxed_edges.iter().any(...)` is an existence check.
- `crates/jet-codegen/src/Codegen/Context.rs:2974-2980`: `return_view_provenance.values()` only populates a parameter-index set.
- `crates/jet-codegen/src/Codegen/Context.rs:3293-3296,3329-3332`: temporary extern/undo HashMaps only populate lookup maps; no emitted iteration occurs here.
- `crates/jet-codegen/src/Codegen/Context.rs:3748,3780-3781,3854,3903-3904,3942-3943,3969-3970`: Core map values are used only by `any` existence predicates.
- `crates/jet-codegen/src/Codegen/Context.rs:4230-4237`: memo keys only populate dependency sets; emitters sort the keys where bytes are produced.
- `crates/jet-codegen/src/Codegen/Context.rs:5569-5577`: index-type HashSet iteration only builds keyed hook lookup entries.
- `crates/jet-sema/src/Sema/BudgetSpecs.rs:132-150,498-520,723-726,952-1020,1135-1144`: registries and selector sets are `BTreeMap`/`BTreeSet`, so validation and diagnostic order are key-ordered.

## Landed owner handoffs

- `crates/jet-codegen/src/Codegen/TIR/emit/expressions.rs:4340-4344,8133-8140,8181-8189` now sorts memo fields and chooses FFI metadata by minimum key; HotLoop2254 landed the fixes.

## Additional landed handoff

- `crates/jet-driver/src/InterpreterBoundary.rs:122-137` now sorts Core import entries by alias and module before selecting the boundary feature.

## Proof target

`tests/build_entry.rs::two_builds_from_two_paths_are_byte_identical` copies this fixture into two `Scratch` roots, builds both with isolated caches, compares generated Rust and native binary bytes plus normalized receipts, and rejects checkout-path-only differences.
